sql: SELECT salary FROM salary WHERE league_id = 'AL'
SELECT T1.birth_country FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.birth_country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.birth_country FROM player AS T1 JOIN hall_of_fame AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.inducted = 'Y' AND T2.yearid >= 1871
SELECT T1.award_id FROM player_award AS T1 JOIN salary AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.award_id ORDER BY max(T2.salary) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT yearid FROM hall_of_fame WHERE needed_note LIKE '%Special Election%'
SELECT T1.birth_country FROM player AS T1 JOIN hall_of_fame AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.inducted = 'Y' GROUP BY T1.birth_country ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT T1.award_id, T2.name_first, T2.name_last, min(T1.year - T2.birth_year) FROM player_award AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.award_id
SELECT T1.award_id, T2.name_first, T2.name_last, max(T1.year - T2.birth_year) FROM player_award AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.award_id
SELECT T2.team_id FROM hall_of_fame AS T1 JOIN salary AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.inducted = 'Y' GROUP BY T2.team_id ORDER BY count(DISTINCT T1.player_id) DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT avg(T1.death_year - T1.birth_year) FROM player AS T1 JOIN hall_of_fame AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.inducted = 'Y' AND T1.death_year IS NOT NULL AND T1.death_year != ''
SELECT T1.notes, avg(T2.weight) FROM player_award AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.notes
SELECT T2.notes FROM hall_of_fame AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T1.inducted = 'Y' GROUP BY T2.notes ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT player_id FROM player_award_vote WHERE year = 1971 ORDER BY points_won DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.birth_month FROM player AS T1 JOIN hall_of_fame AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.inducted = 'Y' GROUP BY T1.birth_month ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT league_id FROM player_award WHERE year = 2006 GROUP BY league_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT notes FROM player_award WHERE player_id = 'willite01'
SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT player_id FROM player_award GROUP BY player_id HAVING count(*) > 10)
SELECT birth_city FROM player GROUP BY birth_city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT avg(T1.weight) FROM player AS T1 JOIN player_award AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id WHERE T2.award_id = 'TSN All-Star' AND T2.notes = '3B'
SELECT player_id FROM salary WHERE year = 2015 ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM Fires WHERE STAT_CAUSE_DESCR = 'Campfire' AND STATE = 'TX'
SELECT OWNER_DESCR FROM Fires WHERE STATE = 'OR' AND FIRE_YEAR = 2015 ORDER BY FIRE_SIZE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT COUNTY FROM Fires WHERE STATE = 'WA' AND FIRE_YEAR = 2012
SELECT count(*) FROM Fires WHERE STAT_CAUSE_DESCR = 'Arson' AND FIRE_YEAR = 2010
SELECT count(DISTINCT FIRE_YEAR) FROM Fires
SELECT avg(DISCOVERY_DOY) FROM Fires WHERE FIRE_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2004
SELECT STAT_CAUSE_CODE FROM Fires GROUP BY STAT_CAUSE_CODE ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FIRE_YEAR FROM Fires GROUP BY FIRE_YEAR ORDER BY sum(FIRE_SIZE) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM Fires WHERE OWNER_DESCR = 'MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED'
SELECT COUNTY FROM Fires WHERE FIRE_YEAR = 2000 AND COUNTY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COUNTY ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT STAT_CAUSE_DESCR) FROM Fires
SELECT sum(FIRE_SIZE) FROM Fires WHERE STATE = 'NC' AND FIRE_YEAR = 2006
SELECT STAT_CAUSE_DESCR FROM Fires WHERE STATE = 'UT' AND FIRE_YEAR = 1997 ORDER BY FIRE_SIZE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM Fires WHERE COUNTY = 'Gloucester' AND FIRE_SIZE > 10
SELECT STATE FROM Fires GROUP BY STATE ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT STAT_CAUSE_DESCR FROM Fires GROUP BY STAT_CAUSE_DESCR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN OWNER_DESCR = 'PRIVATE' THEN 'private' ELSE 'public' END AS land_type, count(*) FROM Fires GROUP BY land_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM Fires WHERE FIRE_YEAR = 2014 AND STAT_CAUSE_DESCR = 'Campfire'
SELECT sum(FIRE_SIZE) FROM Fires WHERE STATE = 'TX' AND FIRE_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
SELECT STATE FROM Fires GROUP BY STATE ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT STAT_CAUSE_DESCR FROM Fires GROUP BY STAT_CAUSE_DESCR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sum(FIRE_SIZE) FROM Fires
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN FIRE_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 THEN FIRE_SIZE ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN FIRE_YEAR BETWEEN 1990 AND 1999 THEN FIRE_SIZE ELSE 0 END) FROM Fires
SELECT count(*) FROM Fires WHERE OWNER_DESCR = 'MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED'
SELECT ROUND(LATITUDE) FROM Fires GROUP BY ROUND(LATITUDE) ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT groupName, groupYear FROM torrents
SELECT artist, groupName FROM torrents ORDER BY artist
SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM tags
SELECT DISTINCT releaseType FROM torrents
SELECT groupName FROM torrents WHERE groupYear > 2000 ORDER BY totalSnatched DESC LIMIT 5
